# v0.22.3 Helm upgrade fixtures

`v0.22.3-values.yaml.golden` is the unmodified chart defaults at
`7a49e08dde4002227474c6a1b9460f839f0d7565:charts/oberth/values.yaml`.
SHA256: `3bb4acafdad9572af15f46a3b111d94f7827b83d987c80275e74e145d0d7f60c`.

`v0.22.3-stored-config.json` represents that release's stored user configuration:
the production installer wrote secretstore enablement, address, role, public CA,
verified transport and Transit enabled/mount/key (installer.go at that revision).
Endpoints and CA text are public fixture values. Operator settings exercise
explicit false, empty, zero and null values and custom Pod annotations. The old chart's
compatibility defaults are set to the test database identities by the test.
No live cluster, private credential or current-chart defaults supply this fixture.

`v0.22.3-cleaned-values.yaml.golden` is those historical defaults with exactly
secretstore.transit.enabled, secretstore.transit.mount and secretstore.transit.key
removed. The Go upgrade test checks it against the production cleanup function.
The shell chart gate renders it and proves the unmodified historical snapshot is
refused. Real Helm's memory driver exercises upgrade, reinstall and restore with
the old release config and the cleaned snapshot actually passed to Helm.
